top30召回:{}
SELECT
    p.PERIODDATE AS `报表日期`,
    p.A_STOCKSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    p.A_STOCKCODE AS `股票代码`,
    p.ITEM_NAME AS `产品名称`,
    ROUND(p.INCOME/10000, 3) AS `聚氨酯系列营业收入(亿元)`,
    ROUND(p.PRI_RVNU_PCT, 2) AS `该产品占营业收入比重(%)`
FROM
    STK_PRI_INCOME_PRODUCT p
INNER JOIN
    GET_A_SEC_CODE s ON p.COMCODE = s.COMCODE
WHERE
    p.ISVALID = 1
    AND s.ISVALID = 1
    AND p.RPT_TYPE = '合并'
    AND p.PERIODDATE = '2025-12-31'
    AND s.SEC_SNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
    AND p.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%聚氨酯%'
    AND p.INCOME IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    p.PERIODDATE DESC
